scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,API -c cyan,magenta 'npm run dev -w @buildnest/web' 'npm run dev -w @buildnest/api'
scripts.build: npm run build -w @buildnest/contracts && npm run build -w @buildnest/api && npm run build -w @buildnest/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @buildnest/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @buildnest/api && npm run typecheck -w @buildnest/web
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:native && npm run test:qa && npm run test:design && npm run test:routes
